guidance.summary: Sustain medium to long term EBITDA margins between 11% and 13%
guidance.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium - to long -term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

guidance.summary: FMEG EBITDA margin target for FY30 in 8% to 10% range
guidance.quote: So I think when we started the Project Spring and we laid ou t our margin profile, I think it's for FY30. So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.

guidance.summary: Grow FMEG business at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth rate
guidance.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.

guidance.summary: Cable and wires volume growth at 1.5x of market growth
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: What we have called out already, as an anchor to look into the volume growth, is that whatever the market grows, we will do 1.5x of that in cable and wires.

guidance.summary: EPC order book close to INR 9,000 crores to INR 10,000 crores
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: Roughly the order book, I would say it is close to around INR9,000 crores, INR10,000 crores.
